issues.evidence: CSR/CSC identifier arrays now pass through the canonical string/finite-number validator before output construction.
Visualization nodes use a Map keyed through the canonical identifier helper.
Compact expected H2V text uses a null-prototype object and preserves __proto__ as an own data key.
Simple/H2V rejects duplicate canonical hyperedge IDs with both source locations in the diagnostic.
Nullable visualization selections use presence-aware identifier equality; null and undefined no longer equal the literal ID null.
Computed-result construction rejects null/undefined and the 2,001-hyperedge triad path reports over_budget.

deferredObservations.reason: The generated worker clone contains an ordinary object keyed by arbitrary result properties; changing sandbox serialization is outside Stage 1 and protected by Stage 0 preservation.
Generated diagnostic objects are keyed by uploaded filenames; a scoped assessment belongs to a later approved stage rather than a blind Map migration.
graphFingerprint and several fixed-key registries use ordinary objects, but Stage 1 found no evidence that those stores are graph-identifier collections.
